title: US Power Plant Pipeline (EIA-860M) - Point in Time
subtitle: All US generators (planned, operating, retired, canceled), monthly from EIA-860M
description:
Every US electric generator of 1 MW or more from the U.S. Energy Information Administration's Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory (Form EIA-860M): planned (the new-build pipeline, with status and planned operating month), operating, retired, and canceled or postponed. One row per generator, with owner, plant, state, county, balancing authority, technology, energy source, nameplate MW and coordinates.

**Why a point-in-time copy:** EIA replaces this file every month. This dataset is the latest release, and the full history (every release with its SHA-256, plus a change log of new projects, status changes and operating-date slips) lives in the [Queue Ledger](https://beingrealfrank.github.io/queue-ledger/) archive ([GitHub](https://github.com/beingRealFrank/queue-ledger)). A new version is published here after each EIA release (monthly).

**Files**
- `eia860m_generators_latest.csv`: 39,908 rows, 16 columns (described below). `plant_generator_id` is unique. Filter `inventory == "planned"` for the pipeline (about 2,400 generators).

**Ideas**
- Planned MW by state and technology, and by planned operating month.
- Share of planned capacity that is batteries or solar, by balancing authority.
- Operating-date slips between releases, using the change log in the archive.
- Map planned projects from latitude and longitude.

**Source and licence**
Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory (Form EIA-860M), September 2026 data (released October 23, 2026). U.S. government data in the public domain; EIA asks for an acknowledgment with the publication date. Data is preliminary, as EIA states. Owner names that look like private individuals are left blank. Not affiliated with or endorsed by EIA.

resources.description: Every US generator of 1 MW or more from the latest EIA-860M release, one row per generator.

fields.name: plant_generator_id
fields.description: EIA plant ID and generator ID joined with a hyphen; unique per generator.

fields.name: plant_id
fields.description: EIA plant code (numeric). Join key to other EIA files.

fields.name: plant_name
fields.description: Plant name as published by EIA.

fields.name: entity_name
fields.description: Owner or operator (EIA entity name). Blank where the name looks like a private individual.

fields.name: inventory
fields.description: Which EIA-860M sheet the generator is on: planned, operating, retired or canceled_or_postponed.

fields.name: status
fields.description: EIA status text with its code in brackets, e.g. (U) under construction. Planned generators use P, L, T, U, V, TS; operating ones use OP, SB and others.

fields.name: technology
fields.description: Generator technology, e.g. Solar Photovoltaic, Batteries, Natural Gas Fired Combined Cycle.

fields.name: energy_source_code
fields.description: EIA energy source code, e.g. SUN, WND, NG, WAT, MWH.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Two-letter state or territory code of the plant.

fields.name: balancing_authority
fields.description: EIA balancing authority code of the plant, e.g. ERCO, CISO, PJM.

fields.name: operation_date
fields.description: YYYY-MM. Planned operation month for planned generators, actual operating month for operating and retired ones.

fields.name: retirement_year
fields.description: Planned or actual retirement, as published by EIA (year or year-month); blank if none.
